d: We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic GIS I&C Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be working as a GIS I&C Engineer to cover all the activities/actions required to enable switching systems to be successfully installed, repaired and any faults eliminated. You will be responsible for installation of high voltage systems worldwide for PGHV. He/she represents PG in general through his presence and technical knowledge and PGHV specifically in dealings with the client at the installation site. The deadlines issued for each project are adhered to, whereby the cost-performance ratio must always be borne in mind in this respect. He/she embodies the PG QA philosophy, considering the special conditions on the construction sites. You will be responsible for the installation & commissioning work entrusted to him being carried out in perfect technical order.
q: A bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering is required.
Minimum 2-5 years of experience with GIS is preferred.
Previous experience with SF6 GAS-Handling and PGHV Transmission & Sub transmission GIS Product knowledge preferred.
Having capability to use MS project professionally.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

d: Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

We are seeking an experienced and decisive Senior Pavement/Road Lead to oversee a significant marine and port infrastructure project in Kuwait. In this leadership role, you will direct all pavement and road construction activities, ensuring projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in pavement engineering with strong project management capabilities and the ability to lead and motivate a diverse team in a complex, international environment.
Approve pavement designs, trial sections and mix designs (CBGM, base, asphalt, interlock)
Control subgrade, layer compaction, levels and surface regularity for yard equipment loads
Plant and laying method checks; joint and drainage details
Lead and supervise all pavement and road construction activities for the marine/port project, ensuring compliance with design specifications and quality standards
Conduct quality assurance and quality control inspections, implementing corrective actions as needed to meet project requirements
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, environmental regulations, and local Kuwait construction standards throughout all project phases
Manage and mentor a team of engineers, supervisors, and field personnel, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment
Analyze pavement design specifications, material requirements, and construction methodologies to optimize project execution
Prepare and present detailed progress reports, performance metrics, and project documentation to senior management and clients
Coordinate with design teams, procurement, and logistics to ensure timely material delivery and resource availability
Identify and resolve technical challenges and construction obstacles through analytical problem-solving and innovative solutions
q: Minimum 15 years of professional experience in heavy-duty port or airfield pavements projects
Comprehensive knowledge of pavement design, materials, and construction methodologies
Proven expertise in project scheduling, budget management, and cost control
Strong understanding of quality assurance, quality control, and safety compliance standards
Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and manage technical teams effectively
Proficiency with project management software and tools (Microsoft Project, Primavera, or equivalent)
Proficiency with AutoCAD or similar design and drafting software
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to work effectively in international and multicultural environments
Experience managing large-scale infrastructure or marine/port construction projects
Familiarity with Kuwait construction standards, regulations, and local industry practices
Experience with international project delivery and cross-functional team coordination
Knowledge of marine infrastructure, coastal engineering, or port facility construction
Advanced proficiency in project management information systems and data analysis tools

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Built by the world's largest digital asset exchange by trading volume, Binance VIP and Institutional offers access to digital asset solutions for VIP clients and institutions. We work closely with a wide range of market participants, including individual traders, high-frequency trading (HFT) and proprietary trading firms, hedge funds, asset managers and family offices, market makers and brokers, investment banks, and more. Join us to be part of a team that provides top-tier services to the most influential players in the crypto industry.

Our team serves the most sophisticated trading users and participants in the trading and investment industry and we offer you an opportunity to build your portfolio of clients alongside Binance and amongst top colleagues. Work remotely in a global team that covers all parts of the world, where you will get to travel and meet and attract your clients at bespoke events.
